title: Verify: Git CLI committer unit tests
summary: Unit tests proving the Committer CLI implementation uses the configured bot identity.
description: Unit tests written from the requirement spec with a fake command runner only. Context: a Committer interface with a CLI implementation using the configured bot identity. Expected result: all listed tests pass.
acceptance_criteria: Given a CLI committer, when Commit runs, then it executes git add -- <path> then git commit with the bot name and email in the working dir
Given the runner fails on add, when Commit runs, then commit is not executed and the error is returned
Given an empty path list or a path with .., when Commit runs, then an error is returned and no command runs

preserve: Existing player session handlers in backend/internal/player

technical_constraints: Go 1.22, chi router, no database; persistent data lives in Git as Markdown/YAML
Git writes go through an interface wrapping the Git CLI
definition_of_done: Listed tests pass via the unit command

steps.action: Write test TestCommit_RunsAddThenCommit: fake Runner capturing args; Commit(ctx, ["worlds/a.md"], "msg"); assert call 1 is add -- worlds/a.md and call 2 contains user.name=bot, user.email=bot@x and commit -m msg.
Write test TestCommit_AddFailureSkipsCommit: fake Runner errors on add; assert 1 call and non-nil error.
Write test TestCommit_RejectsBadPaths: empty slice, "../x" and "/abs" return errors with zero runner calls.
